question: A Clone enters as a copy of Wildblood Pack, the back face of a double-faced card. Can the Clone transform?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the Clone is a copy of the Wildblood Pack but is itself not a double-faced card, so it can't transform.
expected.answer: A Clone enters the battlefield as a copy of Wildblood Pack (the back face of a double-faced card). The Clone will be a copy of the Wildblood Pack. Because the Clone is itself not a double-faced card, it can’t transform.
